October 25, 2026

Hiring Manager
Adolescent Wellness Academy

Re: Virtual Admissions Coordinator: Adolescent Mental Health & Substance Use Treatment

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to express my interest in the Virtual Admissions Coordinator position with Adolescent Wellness Academy. With an MBA and a professional background spanning behavioral healthcare operations, substance use treatment, client services, and program administration, I bring a strong combination of leadership, communication, and organizational skills that align with the needs of your admissions team.

Most recently, I served as Director of Operations at Zephyr Behavioral Health & Wellness, where I was responsible for supporting daily operations, regulatory compliance, staff coordination, clinical documentation processes, and organizational readiness. This experience strengthened my understanding of behavioral healthcare delivery, patient confidentiality, HIPAA requirements, and the importance of maintaining efficient systems that support both clinical teams and the individuals seeking treatment.

In addition to my operational leadership experience, I have worked directly within substance use recovery environments, facilitating behavioral health and wellness groups focused on relapse prevention, healthy routines, coping strategies, and long-term recovery. These experiences have reinforced my ability to communicate with individuals facing difficult circumstances while maintaining professionalism, empathy, and a supportive approach.

What particularly interests me about Adolescent Wellness Academy is your commitment to providing compassionate, individualized treatment while supporting families throughout the recovery process. I understand that the admissions experience is often the first meaningful interaction an individual or family has with a treatment provider. Establishing trust, clearly explaining treatment options, coordinating next steps, and maintaining consistent communication can make a significant difference in helping someone access the care they need.

My background has also equipped me with strong administrative, documentation, and follow-through skills, along with experience navigating behavioral healthcare systems and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams. I am comfortable managing competing priorities, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring that important details are addressed accurately and promptly.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my experience and dedication to both Adolescent Wellness Academy and Principles Recovery Center. I am confident that my combination of behavioral healthcare leadership, direct recovery support experience, and commitment to exceptional client service would allow me to make a meaningful contribution to your admissions team.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background and experience align with your organization's mission and goals.

Sincerely,
Jay Miller, MBA

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Virtual Admissions Coordinator position at Adolescent Wellness Academy. With a professional background in behavioral health, substance abuse treatment, crisis intervention, and healthcare administration, I am confident that my experience and dedication to helping individuals and families would make me a valuable addition to your team.

In my current role as a Rehabilitation Specialist at Anne Arundel Lodge, I work directly with individuals receiving mental health and substance abuse treatment services. My responsibilities include medication administration and documentation, monitoring client well-being, maintaining accurate daily records, supporting treatment plans, and connecting individuals with essential community resources. This experience has strengthened my ability to communicate compassionately, maintain confidentiality, and provide support to individuals navigating challenging circumstances.

Additionally, my previous experience in crisis services and healthcare settings, including Children’s National Hospital and Kaiser Permanente, has provided me with valuable skills in patient communication, customer service, documentation, and navigating sensitive situations with professionalism and empathy.

I understand that the admissions process is often the first step toward recovery and that families seeking treatment deserve to feel heard, respected, and supported. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my experience, strong communication skills, attention to detail, and genuine passion for behavioral health services to Adolescent Wellness Academy.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background and professional experience align with the needs of your organization.

Sincerely,
Kaela Lonon

candidates.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the **Virtual Admissions Coordinator: Adolescent Mental Health & Substance Use Treatment** position. With my  experience supporting individuals with behavioral health needs and mental illness, I am confident that my clinical support skills, compassion, communication abilities, and dedication to patient care would make me a valuable addition to your team.

In my previous role at a 140-bed private psychiatric hospital, I provided care and support to adult patients ranging from geriatric individuals to returning veterans. Working under the direction of nursing and medical staff, I helped patients adjust to new routines, participate in social and therapeutic activities, and complete daily living tasks. I monitored patient behavior, maintained appropriate boundaries, assessed safety concerns, and responded effectively to crisis situations, including assisting with restraints when necessary to prevent injury.

In addition to my direct patient-care experience, I have developed strong skills in behavioral health referrals, admissions, and intake coordination. I am comfortable answering inbound calls and responding to inquiries from clients, parents and guardians, families, referral sources, and healthcare providers. I communicate with patience, empathy, and professionalism while gathering essential information, identifying immediate concerns, and helping families understand available treatment options.

I am familiar with explaining Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP) and Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP) in clear, caring, and easy-to-understand language. I understand that families seeking adolescent mental health or substance use treatment may be experiencing significant stress, and I approach each interaction with sensitivity, respect, and a nonjudgmental attitude. I can help families understand program expectations, levels of care, next steps, and the admissions process while ensuring that urgent safety concerns are communicated promptly to the appropriate clinical staff.

My additional qualifications include:

- Answering inbound calls and responding professionally to inquiries from adolescents, parents, guardians, families, providers, and referral sources  
- Gathering accurate demographic, clinical, insurance, and referral information during initial conversations  
- Screening prospective clients for program fit based on presenting concerns, treatment needs, age, safety considerations, and level of care  
- Explaining PHP, IOP, mental health, and substance use treatment services in a clear and compassionate manner  
- Recognizing potential safety concerns and escalating urgent situations according to established protocols  
- Verifying insurance eligibility and benefits and assisting with authorization-related information  
- Coordinating clinical assessments, intake appointments, admission dates, and required paperwork  
- Communicating with families, providers, clinicians, and other members of the treatment team to support a smooth admissions process  
- Following up consistently with every caller until the individual is scheduled, connected with services, or appropriately referred elsewhere  
- Maintaining accurate and timely documentation in CRM and electronic medical record systems  
- Entering referral and admissions information accurately while protecting confidential patient information  
- Completing documentation in accordance with HIPAA requirements and organizational policies  
- Tracking referrals, follow-up activity, scheduling status, and outcomes to ensure that no inquiry is overlooked  
- Remaining organized, responsive, and professional while managing multiple calls, referrals, and admissions tasks  
- Monitoring patient safety, behavior, vital signs, and overall condition in a psychiatric hospital setting  
- Supporting patients with personal care, daily activities, socialization, and rehabilitation  
- Remaining calm and effective during high-stress conversations and crisis situations  

I am passionate about helping adolescents and families connect with the appropriate behavioral health and substance use treatment services. My combination of hands-on psychiatric experience, referral coordination, insurance verification, admissions support, documentation, and strong interpersonal skills would allow me to contribute effectively to your virtual admissions team.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience and qualifications align with the needs of your organization. I look forward to hearing from you.

Alex Rojas

Kris Secor
Barberville, FL
(386) 453-1015
ksecor65@gmail.com

Dear Adolescent Wellness Academy Hiring Team,

Howdy! I am excited to apply for the Virtual Admissions Coordinator position with Adolescent Wellness Academy because this role reflects the kind of work I have spent years doing: showing up for people when they are struggling, building trust when trust does not come easily, and helping individuals feel supported without judgment.
I bring more than seven years of direct behavioral health experience working with children, adolescents, adults, and older adults facing complex mental health, behavioral, and co-occurring substance use challenges. At Promises Behavioral Health, I supported adults ages 18 to 81 in residential and partial hospitalization settings. My work required constant observation, strong boundaries, de-escalation, crisis response, accurate documentation working with Kipu, teamwork with clinicians, and—perhaps most importantly—the ability to connect with people who were overwhelmed, guarded, resistant, or simply having a very difficult day.
Before that, at Halifax Behavioral Health, I worked with at-risk children and adolescents ages 4 to 17. That experience taught me how much can be communicated without words and how important consistency, patience, calmness, and genuine human connection are when someone does not yet feel safe enough to engage.
Those same lessons have followed me throughout nearly three decades of equine work. Through my current business, Healed By The Horse, I create individualized experiences centered on trust, emotional awareness, regulation, confidence, and connection. Horses have reinforced something I already knew from behavioral health: you cannot force trust. You earn it by being present, observant, consistent, and authentic.
That is what draws me to remote work with Adolescent Wellness Academy.
I understand that meaningful mental health is not achieved by treating a diagnosis while overlooking the person living with it. People need to know that someone sees them, hears them, respects their experience, and will continue showing up. I would bring that mindset—along with substantial hands-on behavioral health experience, strong observational skills, compassion, professional boundaries, and a steady presence—to the Virtual Admissions Coordinator role.
I am also comfortable working independently, communicating virtually, documenting electronically via Kipu, learning new systems, and collaborating closely with multidisciplinary care teams. The opportunity to provide meaningful support within a virtual treatment environment is especially appealing to me.
I would be proud to bring my experience, patience, intuition, and very genuine commitment to helping people to Adolescent Wellness Academy. 

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to speak with you about how I could contribute to your team and, most importantly, to the individuals you serve.

Warmly,

Kris Secor

candidates.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Bilingual Virtual Program Coordinator position at Adolescent Wellness Academy. With experience in case management, program coordination, team supervision, documentation, and remote operations, I have developed the organizational and communication skills necessary to support a virtual behavioral health program effectively.

In my current role as a Case Aide Supervisor, I coordinate daily operations, monitor documentation and reporting requirements, support staff, manage competing priorities, and ensure timely follow-up on assigned tasks. My experience has strengthened my ability to maintain accurate records, communicate expectations clearly, protect confidential information, and collaborate with multiple stakeholders to ensure continuity of services.

As a bilingual professional fluent in English and Spanish, I understand the importance of providing clear, compassionate, and culturally responsive communication to individuals and families. I am comfortable working independently in a remote environment, managing schedules and deadlines, resolving administrative challenges, and escalating concerns to the appropriate leadership when needed.

I am particularly drawn to Adolescent Wellness Academy's mission of helping adolescents build healthier futures through accessible and compassionate mental health care. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my administrative, supervisory, and coordination skills to a team that supports the well-being of teens and their families.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my experience and commitment to quality service can contribute to Adolescent Wellness Academy's virtual program.

Sincerely,  
Sarai Gonzalez

work_history.title: Licensed Psychologist
work_history.summary: Provides individual, couples, and family psychotherapy to children, adolescents, and adults presenting with a range of emotional, behavioral, interpersonal, and psychological concerns. Conducts comprehensive clinical interviews, psychological assessments, and diagnostic evaluations to identify clients' needs, formulate diagnoses, and develop individualized treatment recommendations and intervention plans. Provides trauma-informed psychological services to individuals experiencing trauma-related symptoms, anxiety, depression, adjustment difficulties, life transitions, interpersonal challenges, and other mental health concerns. Develops individualized treatment plans and implements evidence-informed therapeutic interventions designed to strengthen coping skills, emotional regulation, psychological resilience, and overall well-being. Integrates culturally responsive and inclusive approaches to psychotherapy, considering clients' cultural backgrounds, identities, family systems, spiritual beliefs, values, and lived experiences as relevant to treatment. Provides psychological assessment and clinical documentation for specialized cases, including psychological evaluations related to immigration proceedings and other psychosocial circumstances requiring professional psychological assessment. Collaborates and consults with families, attorneys, healthcare professionals, educators, and other professionals when clinically appropriate to support continuity of care and address clients' psychological and psychosocial needs. Provides crisis assessment, risk evaluation, safety planning, psychoeducation, and appropriate referrals to psychiatric, medical, community, or specialized mental health services when indicated. Develops and facilitates psychoeducational workshops, presentations, and educational materials addressing mental health, trauma, emotional well-being, coping strategies, psychological development, and related topics. Maintains accurate and confidential clinical records, including intake documentation, psychological assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, informed consent documentation, and other records in accordance with professional, ethical, and legal standards. Engages in ongoing professional development and integrates contemporary psychological knowledge, trauma-informed practices, and culturally sensitive perspectives into clinical assessment and psychotherapy.

candidates.cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Bilingual Virtual Program Coordinator position at Adolescent Wellness Academy. With a solid background in client-facing coordination, bilingual family communication, and confidential records management, paired with my academic focus in developmental psychology, I am eager to help facilitate seamless daily operations for your adolescent virtual mental health program. I am fully available during your scheduled hours of Monday through Friday from 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM ET and am well-equipped to support your clinical teams, adolescents, and their families remotely.   Throughout my professional experience, I have served as a trusted first point of contact for individuals navigating complex and sensitive environments. In clinical and non-profit settings, I have routinely managed intake coordination, scheduling, and onboarding paperwork while ensuring strict confidentiality and compliance. My role assisting anxious and distressed patients at Nucleo Dental taught me the importance of clear de-escalation, active listening, and calm problem-solving skills that translate directly to coordinating wellness check-ins, monitoring group transitions, and identifying safety concerns for prompt clinical escalation.   Additionally, my administrative experience at Eaton Lighting and El Paso Community College Foundation has built my fluency with high-volume scheduling, database maintenance, virtual communication tools, and cross-functional administrative support. I am fully proficient in both English and Spanish, allowing me to provide empathetic, transparent updates and orientation to bilingual teens and their parents. I am comfortable troubleshooting virtual meeting platforms such as Zoom, tracking attendance and census data, and collaborating independently across remote workflows to ensure no administrative detail slips through the cracks.   Adolescent Wellness Academy’s mission to deliver accessible, structured care to youth ages 13–17 deeply aligns with my passion for mental health and community well-being. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my organization, client-centered care, and bilingual coordination skills to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to speaking with you about how I can contribute to your program. Sincerely, Jessica Guevara Gomez
